# Node

Run node tooling so that it uses the Linux node and the pinned packages. The markdownlint
git hook needs `markdownlint-cli2` from `package-lock.json`.

## Rules

- **Install with `npm ci`, not `npm install`.** It installs exactly what
  `package-lock.json` pins. Commit the lockfile with each dependency change.
- **Run a tool with `npx --no-install TOOL`.** It runs the pinned local package and
  refuses to download a different version.
- **When the markdownlint hook refuses, read its message.** The node it picks, each
  refusal with its fix, its inputs and how to opt out are in
  [markdownlint hook](references/markdownlint-hook.md).
- **When node or npx resolves to a Windows install from a script or hook,** apply
  [the WSL node PATH fix](references/wsl-node-path.md). The `wsl` skill explains why a
  non-interactive shell differs from your terminal.
